user.title: MyMedicalGuardian login
user.description: Enter your MyGuardian caregiver-portal credentials. The name is used as the device title and prefixes every entity (e.g. "Mom Location", "Mom Battery") — pick whatever reads well in your dashboard.

reconfigure.title: MyMedicalGuardian reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Update the credentials or display name for {current_email}. Changing the email moves the integration to a different MyGuardian account.

error.invalid_auth: Login was rejected. Check the email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach mymedicalguardian.com or parse the response.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This MyMedicalGuardian account is already configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: Email cannot be changed to a different account. Delete the integration and add the new one instead.

init.title: MyMedicalGuardian polling
init.description: How often to poll the portal (minutes). MG updates roughly hourly; 10 min is a sensible default.

fetch_failed.message: Could not fetch latest data from MyGuardian portal: {reason}

auth_failed.message: MyGuardian login rejected — credentials are no longer valid.

portal_unreachable.title: MyGuardian portal unreachable
portal_unreachable.description: The MyMedicalGuardian Tracker integration could not reach the caregiver portal for over 24 hours (last error: {reason}). Verify that mymedicalguardian.com is up, that your home network has internet, and that your MyGuardian account is still active. If the portal works in a browser but this integration can't fetch, please [open an issue]({issue_url}) and attach the diagnostics download.
